verdict.rationale: Postmark is a transactional email delivery API, not an agent or AI host that consumes tools, so plugging MCP servers into it as a client is a category error for this kind of product. The community mention of an official Postmark MCP server concerns the server role, which is a separate story and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
